question: Does a matched mirror and a single counterfactual entity-relation word identify the physical endpoint pair and support better geometry for the chosen subject?
scope: Fixed simplified v1, original single observation, no source training, target labels only after sealing, no FINAL. All rows of the historical natural170 (96), natural171 (72), source-own proxy (111) and two target source cross-proxy (222) panels. Development panels have been used before. Source-own and cross-proxy share physical inputs.
eligible: Native parser chooses one direct LEFT/RIGHT edge to an entity. Require explicit edge word, transferable role spans, and a well-defined horizontal direction change. Ineligible or unsupported inputs use unmodified v1 in every arm and stay in every overall denominator.
views: mirrored scene and all horizontal words flipped
unmodified scene with only the entity-relation word reversed
mirrored scene with its entity-relation word reversed relative to the coherent mirror
geometry: The vertical mirror plane passes through the camera center. Its horizontal normal is the horizontal projection of the calibrated camera-right axis. Reflect model-coordinate points before the original PointNet++ forward, keeping point indices; pull back output boxes by the inverse mirror. The virtual camera mirrors the continuous horizontal viewport and carries depth and original z-buffer visibility through this bijection. No new view or pixels. The coherent and opposing sentences on each scene differ only at one relational word.
readout: Across diagonal views and opposing views compute kernel-supported evidence D and N on the same eight subject and eight reference boxes. Kernel is the product of normalized physical overlap for both endpoints. Maximize 2D^2/(D+N). Conditional on that pair, project each contributor box onto the winning box's three axes. Use both endpoint overlaps to weight the positive and negative interval profiles, apply the same contrast pointwise, and maximize normalized support mass on one interval per axis containing the original center. All measured face coordinates plus the anchor center are available endpoints. Keep original on ties. No learned or target-tuned thresholds.
comparison: Congruent-pair average (identical output family), all four averaged (identical inputs and search), direct weighted box fusion, subject-only, product of role marginals, same-scene mismatched reference correspondence, opposite predicate assignment, frozen geometry, fixed v1 pair geometry. All derived from the same sealed traces.
endpoints: Report Acc25/50, mIoU and paired rescue/harm on all rows, subject identity switches with unknown separate; use previously attributable natural reference IDs for dual endpoint accuracy, and category-uniqueness proxies separately. Report geometrical rescue/harm conditional on a correct raw instance, loss of identity, rescue beyond all original A256 raw + PCA, and beyond all four native candidate pools in both yaw conventions. Recount all negatives. Factual and modified boxes scored using two oriented-IoU implementations.
decision: For advancement need evidence of actual correct identity changes attributable to the language relation over equal-information and wrong-correspondence controls, and out-of-pool accurate geometry on confirmed subjects with positive paired balance. Report unresolved denominators, recording heterogeneity and proxy labels. Incremental or underpowered results do not establish novelty or replace v1.
